name: misuse-no-caller

finding.title: A failed handshake in one supervisor loop keeps another loop from dialing the same address for 60 seconds
finding.description: When two supervisor loops run for the same address, one loop's failed handshake sets `backoffUntil` for the address, and the other loop then skips it although its own connection would work. The address is not dialed for up to 60 seconds. Two loops run when `start` is called twice for one address on the same `Dialer`. The only caller, `Client`, calls `start` once in its constructor.

checks: src/net/dialer.ts:13 starts a new loop on every call
src/net/dialer.ts:32 sets the backoff shared by every loop

finding.suggestedFix: Have `start` return early when a loop for `addr` already runs.
